purpose: Historical WebGPU verification of frozen production weights only. This run was not linked to the synthetic weights in m7-equivalence.json; the artifact-linked structural proof is recorded separately in m7-linked-equivalence.json and m7-linked-webgpu.json.
note: Vectors regenerated in commit 802b0e4 because their modelSha256 did not match the then-current production model. The guard now rejects that mismatch. This record does not establish which models were used by earlier browser runs.
outputToleranceNote: The output stage is quantised to 8 bits by the storage texture, so it carries a 1.5/255 floor. A tighter bound would measure the texture format rather than the graph.
verdict: The WGSL graph reproduces the PyTorch reference stage by stage. In f32 every intermediate stage agrees to ~2e-6, which is float32 rounding; the f16 path stays well inside its 5e-2 budget.
